note: Levelling. After a mission each surviving named merc earns XP: xp.deploy for going, xp.objective on a win, per_hit for each hit landed (up to hit_cap), per_kill for each kill, survived_hit for each hit taken and survived (up to survived_hit_cap). levels[i] is the total XP needed for level i + 2 (five levels). Each level offers `offers` different +1 stat steps, drawn with class_weights plus a use bonus (use counters divided by use_divisors), never above caps. The draw is seeded by the campaign seed, the merc and how many picks they have made, so reloading cannot reroll it. Hollows never level.
